sidewalk-condition-rating.title: Sidewalk condition rating 2021
sidewalk-condition-rating.description:
Sidewalk condition data, collected in 2021, is used to report the overall sidewalk condition index (SCI) at the network level and expresses the overall condition of a sidewalk segment by considering surface distresses identified manually in the field.

Distresses were collected as point data. Distress points were averaged to reflect the overall SCI for the entire width and length of the sidewalk segment.

The City plans to collect sidewalk condition data every 4 years.

The City used American Society of Testing Materials (ASTM) D6433 standard as a reference and customize
sidewalk-condition-rating.note: Sidewalk Condition Index per hundred-block segment; a surface-distress rating, not a cause

gwells.source: Province of British Columbia, GWELLS (Groundwater Wells and Aquifers) REST API v1
gwells.units: lithology start/end as served (GWELLS stores feet in these fields; see data dictionary); coordinates WGS84
gwells.note: a logged well is a point record at a distance; the tool names the nearest one and its distance and never interpolates
